snippet.title: František Šebej: Ako sa palestínska a sovietska propaganda zmocnili agendy OSN – od 70. rokov dodnes
snippet.description:
František Šebej, osobnosť ponovembrovej politiky, psychológ a výrazný diskutér o Blízkom východe, sa vracia do štúdia Argument.sk. Východiskom rozhovoru je septembrové Valné zhromaždenie OSN v New Yorku: odchod delegácií počas prejavu Benjamina Netanjahua a vystúpenia Sergeja Lavrova, Recepa Tayyipa Erdoğana, jordánskeho kráľa Abdalláha a Javiera Mileiho.

Rozhovor sa posúva do histórie. Šebej pripomína rezolúciu Valného zhromaždenia 3379 z roku 1975, ktorá stotožnila sionizmus s rasizmom, výsledok hlasovania a jej zrušenie v roku 1991. Rozoberá aj sériu konferencií v Durbane od roku 2001 a bojkoty, ktoré ich sprevádzali.

V závere sa venuje agentúre UNRWA: ako vznikla, kto ju financuje, ako definuje palestínskych utečencov a prečo ju považuje za prekážku riešenia. Zaznie aj otázka, ako by sa OSN mohla reformovať, aby plnila úlohu, pre ktorú vznikla.

Hodnotenia v rozhovore sú osobným pohľadom hosťa.

Päť kľúčových tém
1. Odchod delegácií z Netanjahuovho prejavu – podľa Šebeja išlo o organizované gesto; kto odišiel, kto zostal a ako to prezentovali médiá.
2. Prejavy na Valnom zhromaždení – Lavrov, Erdoğan, kráľ Abdalláh, Milei a pripomenutie vystúpenia Idi Amina v roku 1975.
3. Rezolúcia 3379 – hlasovanie z novembra 1975, vtedajšie zloženie členských štátov a zrušenie rezolúcie v roku 1991.
4. Durban 2001 a jeho pokračovania – séria konferencií o rasizme a rastúci bojkot demokratických štátov.
5. UNRWA a reforma OSN – vznik agentúry, financovanie, dedičný štatút utečenca a Šebejov záver, že OSN potrebuje zásadnú reformu.

내년 법무부와 성평등가족부를 시작으로 오는 2031년까지 외교부, 통일부, 국방부 등 수도권 중앙행정기관 44곳이 세종으로 이전합니다.

정부는 방송미디어통신위원회, 개인정보보호위원회, 원자력안전위원회, 국가인권위원회, 국가교육위원회, 재외동포청 등 별도 청사가 필요 없는 6개 기관 이전을 내년 상반기에 우선 추진합니다.

윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 오늘(13일) 브리핑을 열고 이같은 내용을 담은 2차 중앙행정기관 이전 계획을 밝혔습니다.

이번 이전 대상은 모두 44개 기관으로, 공무원 정원 기준 9,929명 규모입니다.

먼저 별도 청사가 필요하지 않은 27개 기관, 2,995명은 세종 지역 민간 임차 공간을 활용해 내년 중 단계적으로 이전합니다.

상반기에는 방송미디어통신위원회, 개인정보보호위원회, 원자력안전위원회, 국가인권위원회, 국가교육위원회, 재외동포청 등 6개 기관의 이전이 먼저 추진됩니다.

하반기에는 금융위원회를 비롯해 각 부처 소속기관 및 각종 자문위원회 등 나머지 19개 기관을 이전해, 임차 청사 활용 기관 이전을 내년 안에 마무리할 계획입니다.

법무부와 성평등가족부의 경우 행복도시법 개정 시기에 맞춰 이전 시점을 정할 계획입니다.

수사·보안·관제 등 업무 특성상 독립청사와 특수시설이 필요한 17개 기관, 6,934명은 2031년까지 별도 청사를 신축한 뒤 순차적으로 이전할 계획입니다.

신축 후 이전하는 기관은 외교부, 통일부, 국방부, 감사원, 경찰청, 공소청, 중수청, 고위공직자범죄수사처 등이 해당된다고 윤 장관은 밝혔습니다.

또 "대통령비서실, 국가안보실 등 대통령 연계 기관의 이전은 대통령 집무실 완전 이전 시기 등을 고려하여 별도로 검토하겠다"며, "2033년 국회 세종의사당이 완공되면, 세종은 명실상부한 행정의 중심지로서 면모를 갖추게 된다"고 설명했습니다.

정부는 공공기관 이전 계획의 경우 올해 4분기 중 발표할 수 있도록 준비하고 있고, 대법원과 헌법재판소, 중앙선거관리위원회 등 헌법기관 이전은 국회에 관련법이 발의된 상태라고 밝혔습니다.

Baby Ben loves candy, cookies, snacks, and watching TV. But when it's time to brush his teeth, he always says NO! 😲

Henry and Lily try their best to convince Baby Ben to brush his teeth. They bring a toothbrush and toothpaste, but Ben doesn't want to listen. Even when Dad tries a fun idea, Ben still wants to do things his own way.

Then, something unexpected happens... Baby Ben gets a toothache! 😢 Can Mom help him feel better? Will Ben finally learn why brushing his teeth every day is so important?

❤️ Watch this heartwarming family story to discover how Baby Ben learns an important lesson about dental hygiene, healthy habits, and listening to his family.

snippet.title: Prosecution drops 3 impeachment articles vs Sara Duterte
snippet.description:
Good evening. You’re watching The Manila Times’ News Prime.
Today is October 13th.

Our top story.

The Senate impeachment court accepted the prosecution’s withdrawal of three of the four articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte. That leaves only the charge of alleged unexplained wealth for trial. Presiding Officer Chiz Escudero said the articles on confidential funds, bribery, and grave threats are considered withdrawn. Escudero said the withdrawal carried legal consequences that the prosecution must accept. Under the conditions set by the impeachment court, articles on confidential funds and grave threats are deemed withdrawn with prejudice. This means they cannot be revived, refiled or prosecuted anew against Duterte during the same term. Escudero added that the House of Representatives could not refile the two articles during the 20th Congress. The ruling followed the prosecution’s argument that focusing on one article would streamline the proceedings. The prosecution said this would allow the court to concentrate on evidence it considers sufficient to support Duterte’s removal from office. The defense questioned the withdrawal of the articles. They argued that Duterte should retain the opportunity to challenge allegations already presented before the senator-judges.
Read more: https://tmt.news/2444253

Electricity rates for October will go up. This was announced by Meralco. The new rate will be 15 pesos and six centavos per kilowatt-hour. The previous rate was 14 pesos and seventy-four centavos per kilowatt-hour recorded in September. For residential customers of Meralco consuming 200 kilowatt-hours, this adjustment translates to an increase of around 64 pesos in the total electricity bill. Meralco says that the reason for the increase was mostly due to the higher generation charge for the period, but partially offset by lower transmission rates.
Read more: https://tmt.news/2444254

The House of Representatives has approved on third and final reading a bill that would prohibit children below 13 years old from creating or using social media accounts. The measure also seeks to restrict teenagers' access to online features that expose them to harm or encourage excessive use. It is called the Safe and Friendly Environment for Kids in Digital Spaces or SAFE KIDS Act. The House approved the measure with 287 votes in favor, three against and none abstaining. The bill seeks to address risks associated with children's use of social media and online gaming platforms. These risks include cyberbullying, online grooming, sexual exploitation and exposure to harmful content.
Read more: https://tmt.news/2444256

A Michael Jordan road jersey from the 1998 NBA Finals was sold for 14-million dollars. The red jersey is the one Jordan wore in Game 2 of that series on June 5, 1998. It was also autographed by Jordan. Jordan and the Chicago Bulls beat the Utah Jazz that night. Chicago would eventually win the series in six games.
